policy: V16 adds independently evidenced liquidity resources, content-addressed maturity translation, and deterministic liquidity.replay/v1. Restated accounting metrics remain separate from LCR inputs; no horizon resource is inferred from NAV alone and no unreferenced maturity snapshot may be introduced retrospectively.

additions.authority_note: Evidence-bound horizon-specific 1w/4w/8w available resources for one StatementReplay. Resources are non-decreasing by horizon and cannot exceed restated liquid haircut assets. Measurement only; no accounting or execution authority.
Content-addressed translation for one exact maturity.snapshot/v1. Same-currency rate must be exactly 1; cross-currency translation requires explicit evidence. Translation is reference-only.

Deterministic 1w/4w/8w LCR replay from StatementReplay-bound liquid resources and the exact maturity snapshot refs already sealed by the original FinancialSnapshot. V1 requires exact as_of equality and cannot authorize distributions or execution.
